import hashlib, json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT, read_json, write_json, file_sha256, utc_now, machine_id

run='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v14'
tail='8b625e5b7cd016cc23751af9c252cbe0eea69544'
record_path=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261026-v13-tail-publication-reconciled.json'
record=read_json(record_path)
assert record['status']=='all_v13_tail_originals_and_tested_code_delivered_verified'
assert record['publication_commit']==tail and record['actual_retry_publisher_exit_code']==0
assert record['retry_wrapper_process_id']==17052
record.update(actual_retry_unified_session_id=85947, actual_retry_wrapper_exit_code=0, wrapper_terminal_exit_observed_at_utc=utc_now())
write_json(record_path,record)
state_path=ROOT/'runtime/resume-low-20261025/publisher-resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v13.json'
state=read_json(state_path)
assert state['status']=='finished_at_owner_boundary_or_original_deadline' and state['last_commit']==tail
state['reconciliation_sha256']=file_sha256(record_path)
write_json(state_path,state)
profile=ROOT/'runtime/v14-window-profile-20261026.json'
profile_out=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-performance/20261026-v14-partial-window-profile.json'
assert not profile_out.exists()
profile_out.write_bytes(profile.read_bytes())
assert file_sha256(profile_out)==file_sha256(profile)
raw=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-X','utf8','runtime/low-production-status-20261025.py',run],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',check=True).stdout
snapshot=json.loads(raw)
assert snapshot['state']['status']=='running' and snapshot['state']['created_at_utc']=='2026-10-25T21:44:59.205420+00:00'
priority=read_json(ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-priority.json')['sources']
denominators={tier:sum(bool(p['high_priority'])==(tier=='HIGH') for p in priority.values()) for tier in ['HIGH','LOW']}
assert denominators=={'HIGH':4535,'LOW':703}
percentages={tier:round(100*snapshot['counts'][tier]['ready']/denominators[tier],4) for tier in denominators}
percentages['ALL']=round(100*sum(snapshot['counts'][tier]['ready'] for tier in denominators)/sum(denominators.values()),4)
progress=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-progress/20261026-v14-ongoing.json'
assert not progress.exists()
free=shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free
write_json(progress,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'status':'ongoing_not_a_stop_or_completion','actual_snapshot':snapshot,'snapshot_stdout_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),'denominators':denominators,'percentages':percentages,'verified_originals_from_this_execution':411,'last_verified_commit':tail,'actual_tail_readback':record['tail_actual_full_readback'],'partial_timing_evidence':profile_out.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'partial_timing_evidence_sha256':file_sha256(profile_out),'free_bytes_observed':free,'retention_review_unchanged':'2026-10-29T10:30:00Z','scope':'Actual partial ongoing run. Returned PNGs, art-approved sources, committed/pushed objects and complete fixed-commit original-byte verification are separate. HIGH service refusals remain skipped and incomplete. Builtin only; no EvoLink, external image API, Steam/game interaction or full export. No cleanup or protection renewal.','source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
doc=ROOT/'docs/handoffs/2026-10-26-low-v14-progress.md'
assert not doc.exists()
low=snapshot['counts']['LOW']['ready'];high=snapshot['counts']['HIGH']['ready']
doc.write_text(f'''# 钢奶龙心：LOW 持续生产进展

机器 `{machine_id()}`，UTC `{snapshot['observed_at_utc']}` 的进行中快照；本文件不暂停生产，也不表示任务完成。

HIGH 合格 {high}/4535（{percentages['HIGH']:.2f}%）；LOW 合格 {low}/703（{percentages['LOW']:.2f}%）；全部 {high+low}/5238（{percentages['ALL']:.2f}%）。[实际状态](../../mod_nailong/data/production-progress/20261026-v14-ongoing.json)保留同机调用数、输出数、准备余量及证据边界。已跳过的 HIGH 服务拒绝仍计入未完成范围。

上一批固定提交 `{tail}` 已普通推送，UTC `{record['tail_actual_full_readback']['completed_at_utc']}` 完成原始 PNG 核验。V13 实际27次调用、26张PNG、1次服务拒绝；初批15张和尾批11张均已核验。本执行链累计411份原始PNG交付并核验；这不是411张新增合格头像。首次网络发布65720实际退出1，随后同一提交的Git专用恢复85947实际退出0。[恢复记录](../../mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261026-v13-tail-publication-reconciled.json)及原失败字节均保留，没有重发图片请求。

V14 唯一内置生成者从索引853接续，实际启动UTC21:44:59.205420，固定截止23:44:59.205420。单路连续调用，两审图槽只排SHA绑定决定，由唯一生成者在边界应用。根审图槽已实际完成b129–b132共16张，7通过、9返修；a槽另有独立报告，不把尚未实际审图的输出计作通过。

[部分耗时记录](../../mod_nailong/data/production-performance/20261026-v14-partial-window-profile.json)反映启动到最近完成窗口约38.5分钟：图片工具237.253秒，本地命令900.723秒，其中准备边界615.512秒。窗口外时间623.633秒包含调度、准备和传输等，未全部归因；窗口内也有未分类时间。不是完整小时或受控对照，不据此宣布速度恢复。当前重复边界调用值得优化，但不能牺牲每次请求的实际词/输入校验、HIGH重查、拒绝冷却或审图。

Windows JSON共享读取/原子替换修复已在上述提交交付，100项相关测试实际通过，保留此前失败试验。不承诺解决所有权限错误。仍仅使用内置图片工具，不使用同事的EvoLink skill；没有新Steam离线/游戏显示证据。原保护复核期限2026-10-29T10:30Z不变，未清理文件或整库导出。
''',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
paths=[
 'docs/handoffs/2026-10-26-low-v14-helper-sources.json',
 'docs/handoffs/2026-10-26-low-v14-progress.md',
 'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261025-low-v14.json',
 'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261026-low-v14-started.json',
 'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261026-v13-tail-publication-reconciled.json',
 'mod_nailong/data/production-performance/20261026-v14-partial-window-profile.json',
 'mod_nailong/data/production-progress/20261026-v14-ongoing.json',
]
paths += ['mod_nailong/data/production-checkpoint-failures/20261026-v13-tail-network-failure'+suffix+'.json' for suffix in ['', '-original-publication','-original-publisher-state','-original-prior-reconciliation-observation']]
paths += [f'mod_nailong/data/production-review-handovers/20261025-root-rollingb{n}.json' for n in range(129,133)]
for name in paths:
    assert (ROOT/name).is_file()
    if name.endswith('.json'):read_json(ROOT/name)
assert free>30_000_000_000
def git(*args,timeout=180):
    p=subprocess.run(['git',*args],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=timeout)
    if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError(p.stdout+'\n'+p.stderr)
    return p.stdout.strip()
lock=ROOT/'runtime/production-publish.lock'
fd=os.open(lock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY)
with os.fdopen(fd,'w',encoding='utf-8') as f:json.dump({'machine_id':machine_id(),'process_id':os.getpid(),'batch':'v14-static-progress-20261026','acquired_at_utc':utc_now()},f)
receipt_path=ROOT/'runtime/v14-static-progress-published-20261026.json'
receipt={'machine_id':machine_id(),'started_at_utc':utc_now(),'paths':paths,'scope':'Exact static evidence only. No canonical portrait rows, colleague experiments, image generation, force push or working-file replacement.'}
try:
    assert git('branch','--show-current')=='master'
    assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only')
    git('fetch','origin','master')
    assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==git('rev-parse','origin/master')==tail,'Inspect advanced remote before staging'
    git('diff','--check','--',*paths)
    git('add','--',*paths)
    assert set(git('diff','--cached','--name-only').splitlines())==set(paths),'Exact static staging scope changed'
    git('commit','-m','Record verified LOW delivery and ongoing production')
    commit=git('rev-parse','HEAD')
    receipt.update(status='committed_push_pending',commit=commit);write_json(receipt_path,receipt)
    receipt['push_stdout']=git('-c','gc.auto=0','-c','maintenance.auto=false','-c','http.version=HTTP/1.1','push','origin',commit+':refs/heads/master',timeout=900)
    observed=git('ls-remote','origin','refs/heads/master').split()[0]
    if observed!=commit:git('merge-base','--is-ancestor',commit,observed)
    receipt.update(status='committed_and_pushed',remote_master_observed=observed,completed_at_utc=utc_now())
finally:
    write_json(receipt_path,receipt)
    assert read_json(lock)['process_id']==os.getpid()
    lock.unlink()
print(json.dumps({'status':receipt['status'],'commit':receipt['commit'],'files':len(paths),'LOW_ready':low,'LOW_percent':percentages['LOW'],'ALL_percent':percentages['ALL'],'free_bytes':free}),flush=True)
